# Approach

PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC has engaged us to deliver a robust and scalable Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting solution, leveraging their existing data and analytics landscape. Our methodology is based on a phased, collaborative approach that drives alignment across data, technology, and marketing teams to ensure business objectives are achieved and actionable insights are realized in an accelerated timeframe. We will leverage industry-leading practices to design, develop, and automate the necessary data pipelines and reporting assets, using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Power BI as core technologies with critical integration of Salesforce and QuickBooks.

The engagement will be structured in two sequential phases: an expedited Design Phase (Phase 3A), followed by a focused Build Phase (Phase 3B). Each phase will be executed with clear deliverables, structured stakeholder engagement, and detailed project management to ensure timely completion. The approach will include requirements gathering, data assessment, blueprinting, technical architecture, development, and rigorous validation, all oriented towards delivering an automated and insightful reporting suite for L2A and CAC.

---

**Phase 3A: Design & Solution Blueprint, Duration: 3 weeks, Timeline: Week 1 to Week 3**  
**Summary:** The Design Phase focuses on capturing requirements, assessing current state data, designing the L2A/CAC data model, and developing technical blueprints and mockups for the Power BI reports.

**Activities:**  
- Conduct stakeholder workshops with data, technology, and marketing teams to refine reporting requirements and KPIs  
- Perform data gap assessment and quality review for Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and QuickBooks  
- Architect detailed L2A and CAC data models, mapping data flows and defining KPI logic  
- Develop mockups (up to 8 views) of the Power BI L2A/CAC reporting suite  
- Document the Technical Approach, data model design, and integration requirements (esp. QuickBooks)  
- Deliver KPI Book, Data Gap Assessment, a Technical Approach document, and a detailed Phase 3B Implementation Plan  

---

**Phase 3B: Build & Implementation, Duration: 8–12 weeks, Timeline: Week 4 to Week 15**  
**Summary:** The Build Phase centers on developing automated pipelines, integrating new data sources, constructing the Power BI reports, and delivering a scalable reporting solution aligned with the design artifacts.

**Activities:**  
- Develop and test batch data ingestion/ETL pipelines for QuickBooks integration using Microsoft Fabric  
- Implement data transformation, cleansing, and consolidation routines for L2A and CAC reporting  
- Build and configure the L2A and CAC data models and Power BI reporting suite as per Phase 3A designs  
- Validate data integrity, report functionality, and alignment to defined KPIs in UAT sessions with stakeholders  
- Conduct user training and knowledge transfer for business and technical teams on new dashboards  
- Finalize project documentation, handover assets, and present the scalable roadmap for future enhancements  

---

This phased approach ensures PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC receives immediate value through rapid alignment of business needs and technical feasibility, while also setting the foundation for a resilient and extensible reporting environment. By closely integrating stakeholders throughout each phase and focusing on robust design and implementation best practices, we will empower Pure’s leadership with timely, accurate, and actionable insights for pipeline optimization and marketing ROI assessment.
